errors.text: The proposed BCC lattice contraction of only 0.005–0.010 Å is substantially smaller than the target contraction from approximately 3.392 Å to 3.325 Å (about 0.067 Å), so the stated quantitative boundary condition is incorrect.
The illustrative Laves composition '(Hf,Mo,Ta,Zr)2Cr' reverses the target Cr-rich stoichiometry, Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta), and includes Mo where the target phase designation does not.
